answer: We construct a Sybil-resistant mechanism via dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices, deploying a cryptoeconomic atlas to anchor identities using strict staking collateral. Enforcing zero-knowledge verifiable delay and slashing penalties, this primitive mathematically proves the expected payoff of identity multiplication across any adversarial vine remains strictly negative. Thus, insurmountable capital barriers compel rational agents to converge toward a robust Nash equilibrium, ensuring strictly negative attack utility.
